answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake before earning. A lone honest agent pays once, like a single island with one harbor to guard, while a sybil attacker must fund each fake identity, so cost scales linearly with sock-puppet count. Misbehavior forfeits the bond, and refunds vest slowly, arriving like a comet on a long orbit, so throwaway identities cannot cash out quickly. By contrast, a free reputation score is as fragile as ivory: pretty, but easily carved into as many copies as an attacker wants.
